title: Access paths are safe run segments
statement: For either access mode, if there is an access path from a configuration $c$ on input $y$ to a configuration $c'$, then some natural number $T$ satisfies that the run of the access program from $c$ reaches $c'$ at time $T$, and every configuration at times $t<T$ has all work-head positions between $-1$ and the length of the binary representation of $|y|+1$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: There is an access path from $c$ to $c'$
